title: Prague · Bohemian Switzerland Sandstone Roads
slogan: A 215 km loop out of Mělník river
story: Sandstone walls, river bends and a proper northbound escape. Out of Mělník and back again: 213 km, roughly 3 h 40 in the saddle. On the way it passes Hřensko gorge, Děčín cliffs and Litoměřice. It keeps to quiet secondary roads.
